name: Crypto Girl
source:
2017, alternative reality, mining and crypto-currencies have gained immense popularity around the world. Everyone began to farm the crypto-currencies (bitcoins, litecoins, namecoins, and others), even in Uganda, African Americans united, collected PC and began to earn the entire country with a crypto currency. That's an ordinary girl from South Korea, Dokkaebi decided to farm the crypto currency, because everyone else does it too. Just hype. But because of mining in the world terrible things began to happen - video cards were not enough, people even began to fight for video cards and the dollar with the ruble began to fall down. What happened next? Learn the game, without SMS.
Learn the story of an ordinary girl Dokkaebi who decided to become a miner and farm the crypto currency.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/820300/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2017年，另类现实、挖矿和加密货币在全球范围内大受欢迎。每个人都开始种植加密货币（比特币、莱特币、域名币等），甚至在乌干达，非裔美国人也团结起来，收集个人电脑，开始用加密货币为整个国家赚钱。Dokkaebi是一位来自韩国的普通女孩，她决定种植加密货币，因为其他人也这样做。只是炒作。但由于采矿业，世界上可怕的事情开始发生——显卡不够了，人们甚至开始争夺显卡，美元与卢布开始下跌。接下来发生了什么？学习游戏，无需短信。
了解一个普通女孩Dokkaebi决定成为一名矿工并种植加密货币的故事。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/820300/]Steam[/url]]
